data.body: Fixed by Gerrit change 3269, merged f1fe7c6f587 (carries this ticket's rebar-ticket trailer). Signers are resolved before the lock and the locked body runs under local_read_context, so a fold neither fetches nor re-requests its own lock. Regression test: test_no_fetch_or_nested_lock_request_while_the_fold_holds_the_lock (bare remote, expired freshness throttle; failed on the old code with reconverge, _coordinated_fetch and acquire all observed under the lock). Deployed: mcp-deployed-sha f1fe7c6f587, healthy 08:55 PST 2026-11-03.
